summary: First Eagle Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting its March 31, 2026 NAV ($23.95/share), regular monthly distributions declared (~$0.21/share payable May 28, 2026), and portfolio metrics (aggregate NAV $297.4M, debt-to-equity 0.95x). The filing is a routine update of financial condition and distributions for a continuously-offering BDC; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or any other special situation. No strategic transaction or corporate action outside ordinary course is disclosed.
